observations: Photo 0 shows a large stack of metal cylinders laid on their sides, viewed end-on from the valve/base end.
Many cylinder rims show heavy rust and corrosion; some rims are painted blue, others bare metal or white.
No brand, model, capacity, or safety certification markings are legible on any cylinder.
No pressure gauge, valve, or regulator is visible on any cylinder to indicate fill level or gas presence.
A watermark/name overlay is present but is just a photo credit, not product information.
Unclear whether the sale is for a single cylinder or the entire stacked lot.

claims.claim: Co2 Gas cylinders for sale with gas inside

risks.proof: A clear photo of the pressure gauge or a weighing/fill-check video.

risks.risk: Heavy rust visible on many rims may indicate corrosion compromising structural integrity or failing safety inspection.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of individual cylinder bodies and valve threads, plus any hydrostatic test stamp.

risks.risk: Cylinder size/capacity (e.g., 20kg, 40kg, small vs industrial) is not stated or visible.
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure or a legible capacity stamp on the cylinder neck.
risks.if_unproven: priced at smallest common capacity assumption

risks.risk: Valve type and condition (threading, leaks, missing cap) unknown, affecting usability.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of an individual valve assembly.

risks.risk: Quantity being sold (single unit vs bulk lot) is ambiguous from the image.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of unit count matched to a photo showing them separated or tagged.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one cylinder showing any capacity/brand stamp near the neck.
Photo of the pressure gauge or valve showing fill status.
Photo with a tape measure or known-size object for scale.
Confirmation of how many units are actually being sold in this listing.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a CO2 gas cylinder, but gas content, condition, and size are unverified, so it must be priced at the worst case of an empty, rusted, unspecified-capacity cylinder until further proof is given.
